I wrote the seven draft forms and `b07_scope_judgments.json` into `rating-run-p6-B/`. All seven pass `validate_form`, except that the author role is empty, as the draft rules require. The judgments file has all 82 items in sheet order.

| Form | Level | Outcome |
|---|---|---|
| B05 | Documented | not performed; no task defects listed |
| B07 | Documented | not performed; the check results were not opened |
| B12 | Undocumented | not performed; no uncertainty measure for the 500 task release |
| B14a | Verified | failed |
| B14b (`CONFIG_02_SOL_MED`) | Verified | passed; limits stated |
| B28a | Verified | failed |
| B28b | Verified | passed; limits stated |

- **B14b:** Source tasks run 2017 to 2023 and target tasks are after the 2026-04-30 cutoff. Probe hits (any file) were 37 of 44 on source and 40 of 44 on target. No exposure difference favouring source tasks was seen, but the probe cannot show absence.
- **B28a:** Patches changing only test runner files were graded resolved on all four checked tasks (`bin/test` and pytest layouts), so release level mutability exists. `POLICY-P6-CONTROLLED` applies per case as a condition on each Protocol 6 session, not to the benchmark release.
- **Blind B07 sheet:** 78 `states_broken_behavior`, 3 `unclear` (30304, 30530, 30311), 1 `does_not_state` (30827).

**Caveats:**
- **B05 and B14a evidence:** I could only quote the repository notes, not the original source pages. The B05 rating therefore rests on description only.
- **B05 task defects:** The one executed counterexample, for 18199, shows a test that is too wide, which is a B07 matter. No task defect is listed.
- **B28b limits:** The reference fix search ran on 75 Protocol 4 images, not all Protocol 6 tasks.
